column3: With respect to the Marriott Albuquerque Mortgage Loan (6.6%), the Phase I ESA identified as a controlled recognized environmental condition (“CREC”) for the Mortgaged Property residual soil contamination 30-35 feet below ground surface identified in two releases, one in 1995 and the other in 2022; however, the Phase I ESA consultant determined that the Mortgaged Property did not pose an immediate public health or environmental threat and did not require any additional work. In addition, depth of groundwater is estimated to be greater than 300 feet below ground surface. Based on 1995 and 2022 case closures with conditions, the ESA concluded that the residual soil contamination that remained on the Mortgaged Property is a CREC.
